us.description:
Rock Drum Machine is a rock drummer in your pocket. It does not loop a recording: it plays like a drummer, adding ghost notes, open hi-hats and fills that change every time. Practice, write songs and play live with drums that feel alive.
FREE TO START
Download it free and use everything for 7 days. Then unlock the full version with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.
Already own Rock DM? Your full version stays unlocked. Nothing to buy again.

A DRUMMER THAT JAMS
•  JAM and INTENSITY: go from a steady beat to a busy, improvising drummer
•  Fills of variable length that come in the way a drummer would play them, with triplet fills and double bass drum
•  Automatic fills every few bars, or fire them yourself
•  Humanize, from Perfect to Drunk

ROCK, FROM CLASSIC TO ODD TIMES
•  114 grooves and 70 fills in 6 banks: Rock, Grunge, FunkRock, Shuffle, Progressive and Odd Times
•  65 real drum sounds, most recorded in three dynamic layers: ghost, normal and accent
•  25 factory kits plus two round-robin kits, Stage RR and Vintage RR
•  Create or edit your own grooves in Edit Mode and Patterns Mode, and save them in your own banks

PRACTICE, WRITE, PERFORM
•  Song Mode: chain grooves and fills into full songs
•  8 Live Pads: switch grooves and fire fills on the fly, with a countdown to the change
•  Portrait layout on iPhone, so it sits on your music stand
•  Mixer with volume, pan and reverb send for every drum
•  Four effects: Compressor / Gate, Equalizer, Delay and Reverb
•  External keyboard support: Space to play and stop, Enter for a fill

IN YOUR STUDIO
•  AUv3 plug-in, plus a new MIDI-only plug-in to drive any other drum instrument
•  Sound Module: play the kit as a MIDI sampler from your pads or keyboard
•  MIDI Setup: independent MIDI Clock in and out, MIDI-controllable tempo, shareable maps
•  Send and receive grooves and Live Pad Sets with the other Lumbeat drummers and iBassist
•  Share a groove or a song by AirDrop, Mail or Files
•  Export full audio, multitrack stems and MIDI
•  Ableton Link and MIDI Clock sync

MORE DRUMMERS
Mike (Progressive Rock, with heavier, metal-style fills) and John (Classic Rock) are available as separate in-app purchases, each with their own kit and playing style. They are not included in the full version.
Requires iOS 16 or later.

us.description:
Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you.

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge!
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

■ Unique Heroes — Not just different stats. A completely different way to play.

Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.

…Every hero demands a different strategy.

■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy.

Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot

Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary
Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations.

■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything.

Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.

Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases.

■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here.

Normal mode is only the beginning.
As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await.

Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations.

■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week.

Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week.
Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work.

Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings.
Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle.

How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger?

■ Endless Replayability

3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time

Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike.

■ Features

Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite
Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings
Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies
Procedurally generated dungeons
Multiple languages supported
Cloud save

Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.

- Added a prologue.
- Promotion Pact now applies only to lower-tier units.

- Adjusted Infinite Battlefield difficulty.

Hello Hello, iPhone Duo
- New support for iPhone Duo, with layouts for both screens.

Deco is now free
- Deco is now free to download, with Deco Plus available as a one-time purchase. Choose your price—every option includes all Plus features.
- The free library includes three wallpapers, two widgets and ten saved stickers.
- If you bought Deco before 3.0, you keep your paid access.

A whole new canvas
- A completely redesigned canvas and editor give your artwork more room, with tools that adapt to iPhone and iPad.
- One creation can become wallpapers in multiple sizes, including iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and custom dimensions.
- Create a different sticker layout for each wallpaper size and orientation.
- Search and reorder stickers in Layers, with undo and redo across your canvas edits.

Make it move

- New reveal animations bring stickers into view with Fade In, Staggered, Bloom and Bounce.

Create together, with iCloud
- Your creations and sticker library come to your other devices with new iCloud sync.
- Collaborate on editable creations through iCloud, with Activity History showing recent changes.

Beyond your wallpaper
- Create Home Screen widgets in their own library, with a separate layout for each size.
- Export and import editable widget files.
- Export your creations as Apple Watch faces.
- Deco Live for Mac is available as an early access download in Settings.

Find your next idea

And more

- Top Picks tailors celebration suggestions to your region.
- Optional automatic names for wallpapers and widgets using Apple’s Private Cloud Compute.
- New Shortcuts actions create random or custom wallpapers and work with selected or random stickers.
- Saved stickers can appear in the system sticker picker.
- Search Settings and change matching controls directly in the results.
- Rotate photo backgrounds, with improved framing, stripe editing and gradient controls.

- Fixed a crash that could prevent Deco from opening on iOS 26.
- Tapping + in Wallpapers starts a new creation again.
- Rotate photo backgrounds with a two-finger twist.
- Improved photo editing with more space around the preview, animated transitions between controls and clearer spacing between zoom percentages.
- Available wallpaper previews now remain visible when another layout’s thumbnail is missing. Missing previews show “Preview unavailable” without preventing editing.
- Delete wallpapers or leave shared wallpapers while offline; changes sync when connected.
- Fixed unresponsive widget previews and missing rounded corners in Widgets.
- Clearer error screens when an export can’t be prepared.
- Creation details now explain when sticker content is unavailable, with one Retry action.
us.description:
Make wallpapers, widgets, and watch faces with your photos, text, emoji, and stickers. Create something for your own screens or share it with friends.

MAKE IT YOURS
Start with a photo, a gradient, stripes, or a solid color. Turn photo cutouts, words, and emoji into stickers. Choose fonts, colors, outlines, and finishes, then move, resize, rotate, and layer your stickers.

WALLPAPERS, WIDGETS, AND WATCH FACES
Make wallpapers for iPhone and iPad or choose custom dimensions. Create Home Screen widgets with a separate layout for each size. Export your artwork as an Apple Watch face. Use your saved stickers in Messages, too.

CREATE AND SHARE
Send an image, share an editable copy, or invite friends to a shared creation. Choose who can view or edit. Friends can join for free.

ADD MOVEMENT AND TEXTURE
Create Live Photo wallpapers with animated sticker effects. Try finishes including chrome, holographic, glitter, embroidery, and risograph, and preview animations as you work.

KEEP YOUR COLLECTION WITH YOU
Keep your creations and sticker library across your devices with iCloud. Search for artwork by what its images show, explore guides and ideas, and use Shortcuts to create and work with your designs.

DECO PLUS
Start free with up to three wallpapers, two widgets, and ten saved stickers. Unlock more with Deco Plus, available as a one-time purchase. Every price option includes the same Plus features. If you bought Deco before version 3.0, you keep your paid access.

tr.description:
A customer appears at your window and tells you what they want. You have two choices: say "Right away!" and open the tray, or tell them you're out and turn them away.

But the game won't count your stock for you. You only see what you have left once the tray is open. You can step back, but the customer's patience keeps ticking.

YOU BUILD THE TRAY
Pick the item, set the portion, add the chili, add the salad, don't forget the drink. Get it right and you earn money and tips; get it wrong or leave something out and the receipt turns red, and the street talks.

THE NIGHT ENDS, THE BILL COMES
Revenue, costs, satisfaction. Restock from the wholesaler, choose your pricing, grow your stall. Tonight's satisfaction decides how many people come to your window tomorrow night.

YOUR PRICES, YOUR CALL
Cheap, normal, expensive. Go cheap and the street loves you but profits melt; go expensive and the till fills up but your name gets around. Stay off normal for too long and the bill arrives at the end of the day.

GROW YOUR STALL
Mussel counter, soup cauldron, grill, dessert case. Every piece of equipment grows your menu and comes with plenty of starter stock; each one is a goal worth saving up for.

WHAT'S ON THE MENU
Kokoreç in a sandwich, in half a loaf or on a plate, İzmir style, liver, sweetbread, köfte, sucuk. Tripe, lentil, head-and-trotter and tuzlama soups. Fried mussels, stuffed mussels. Sütlaç, cold baklava, carrot-slice baklava. Ayran, şalgam, gazoz, soda.

WHO SHOWS UP
The local shopkeeper, the taxi driver, the night-shift worker, the student, the tourist, the fussy auntie, three different football fans, a courier, a biker, a nurse, a police officer, a magician and more: 28 customers in all. Each has their own patience, budget and favorites.

ACHIEVEMENTS AND STATS
Four tiers in every category, 36 Game Center achievements in total. Climb the leaderboard with your career earnings.

YOU CAN GO BUST
There are two ways to lose: the street turns its back on you, or debt drowns you. Both show up a night in advance, because the reason for every loss is written on the receipt.

Survive in endless dungeons by connecting blocks to attack, defend, and heal. Dungeon Tracer is a roguelike puzzle RPG that combines strategic turn-based combat with dungeon exploration. Connect identical blocks to unleash powerful sword attacks, shield defenses, and life-saving potions. Your decisions each turn shape the outcome of battles and your survival.

- Players who enjoy puzzle RPGs and roguelikes

■ Core Gameplay
- Connect blocks to attack, defend, and heal
- Every turn's choice impacts your strategy

Experience the blend of intuitive block connection puzzles and the tactical depth of roguelike RPGs. Your play style varies with block placements, enemy types, skill selections, and item combinations.

Build the dungeon. Set the traps. Wait for the heroes.

Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure.

Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive.

◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero

Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you.

At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes.

Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress.

◆ 26 Trap Rooms, Countless Combinations

Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more.

Combine rooms of the same element to unlock powerful synergies.

Freeze enemies before burning them alive. Trap them in narrow corridors and finish them with poison. Your dungeon layout determines how long the heroes survive.

◆ Transform into Skel and Fight

Traps are not your only weapon.

Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself.

Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line.

When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself.

◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings

Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves.

How long can your dungeon survive?

Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world.

◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time

Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage.

Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score.

Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters.

◆ Grow Stronger with Every Run

Defeat waves to earn Trait Points and unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs stronger.

Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics.

There is always one more strategy to discover.

◆ Full Controller Support

Prefer playing with a controller?

Build rooms, choose perks, use the shop, warp through the dungeon, browse the Collection, and control every major screen with a gamepad.

On-screen button prompts are supported, and you can freely switch between controller and touch controls.

◆ A Premium Dungeon Defense Built for Replayability

Short runs. Deep strategy. And that feeling of wanting to survive just one more wave.

• Dungeon defense combined with roguelike progression
• 26 trap rooms with elemental synergies
• Multiple Skel forms for direct combat
• 7 stages plus an increasingly difficult Endless Mode
• Global ranking competition
• More than 30 perks that change every run
• Permanent upgrades, relics, and hidden synergies
• Full gamepad support
• Cloud save support
• Playable in 13 languages

If you enjoy tower defense games, roguelikes and roguelites, dungeon management, base defense, strategy games, or survivor-style action, Skel & Defense was built for you.

The heroes are already coming.

Build your dungeon, prepare your traps, and show them who the real master of the dungeon is.

tr.description:
A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated

Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps.

This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher.

Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done.

You get:

- Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps
- Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need
- Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message
- Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand
- Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus
- Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision
- Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities
- Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions
- Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have

Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price.

With Goblin Tools Pro, you can:

- Keep your data continuously synced between devices
- Create and reuse templates for to-do items
- Share the lists you create
- Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice
- Access your history across all Goblin Tools
- Use additional Pro features as they are introduced

Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate.

It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more.

Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

Keep your creations and sticker library across your devices with iCloud. Search for artwork by what its images show, explore guides and ideas, and use Shortcuts to create and work with your designs.

pt.description:
Construa a masmorra. Prepare as armadilhas. Espere pelos heróis.

Skel & Defense é um roguelike de defesa de masmorra em que você assume o papel do vilão. Expanda sua masmorra sala por sala, encha-a de armadilhas mortais, transforme-se em Skel e impeça onda após onda de heróis de roubar seu tesouro.

Combine a estratégia de tower defense com a rejogabilidade de um roguelike e construa uma masmorra que nenhum grupo de aventureiros consiga atravessar.

◆ Torne-se o mestre da masmorra

Toda masmorra tem um monstro esperando na escuridão. Desta vez, esse monstro é você.

Durante a noite, expanda a masmorra e prepare suas armadilhas. Durante o dia, defenda os portões das ondas de invasores.

Construa, defenda, melhore e repita. Transforme uma simples cripta subterrânea em uma fortaleza impenetrável.

◆ 26 salas de armadilhas e inúmeras combinações

Combine 26 tipos de salas com bolas de fogo, lava, névoa congelante, estalactites de gelo, serras, flechas envenenadas, campos eletromagnéticos e muito mais.

Reúna salas do mesmo elemento para desbloquear sinergias poderosas.

Congele os inimigos antes de queimá-los. Prenda-os em corredores estreitos e termine o trabalho com veneno. Você decide o layout; sobreviver é problema dos heróis.

◆ Transforme-se em Skel e lute

Armadilhas não são sua única arma.

Transforme-se em diferentes Skels e enfrente os invasores diretamente.

Lance bolas de fogo da retaguarda como Mage Skel, arremesse shurikens como Rogue Skel ou segure a linha de frente como Shield Skel.

Se as armadilhas não forem suficientes, termine o trabalho pessoalmente.

◆ 7 fases, modo infinito e ranking global

Supere 7 fases com diferentes recompensas e depois encare o modo infinito, com ondas cada vez mais difíceis.

Até onde sua masmorra consegue resistir?

Registre um apelido para participar do ranking global e competir com jogadores do mundo inteiro.

◆ Mais de 30 perks, uma partida diferente a cada vez

Escolha entre mais de 30 perks durante cada fase.

Pegue melhorias poderosas ou aceite penalidades perigosas em troca de pontos bônus.

Aposte tudo nas armadilhas, fortaleça seu Skel ou combine as duas estratégias. Cada run é diferente e cada escolha importa.

◆ Fique mais forte a cada run

Derrote ondas para ganhar pontos de características e desbloquear melhorias permanentes para as próximas partidas.

Explore a coleção para encontrar sinergias escondidas, novas salas e relíquias poderosas.

Sempre há mais uma estratégia para descobrir.

◆ Suporte completo a controle

Construa salas, escolha perks, use a loja, teletransporte-se e consulte a coleção usando um gamepad.

Os comandos aparecem na tela e você pode alternar entre controle e toque quando quiser.

◆ Dungeon defense premium feito para jogar várias vezes

Partidas curtas, estratégia profunda e aquela vontade de sobreviver a só mais uma onda.

• Dungeon defense com progressão roguelike
• 26 salas de armadilhas com sinergias elementais
• Diferentes formas de Skel para combate direto
• 7 fases e modo infinito
• Ranking global
• Mais de 30 perks
• Melhorias permanentes, relíquias e sinergias escondidas
• Suporte completo a gamepad
• Salvamento na nuvem
• Disponível em 13 idiomas

Se você gosta de tower defense, roguelike, roguelite, gerenciamento de masmorras, defesa de base, estratégia ou ação estilo survivor, Skel & Defense foi feito para você.

Os heróis já estão chegando.

Construa sua masmorra, prepare suas armadilhas e mostre quem é o verdadeiro mestre.

pt.description:
A corruptive presence has invaded the Federal Bureau of Control… Only you have the power to stop it. The world is now your weapon in an epic fight to annihilate an ominous enemy through deep and unpredictable environments. Containment has failed, humanity is at stake. Will you regain control?


Winner of over 80 awards, CONTROL is a visually stunning third-person action-adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Blending open-ended environments with the signature world-building and storytelling of renowned developer, Remedy Entertainment, CONTROL presents an expansive and intensely gratifying gameplay experience.


CONTROL Ultimate Edition has now been adapted to iOS. We have implemented touch controls and made changes to the in-game UI and game mechanics, like aiming and puzzles to provide a great experience for supported touch devices. The game renders beautifully through Metal and supports Ray Tracing on supported hardware.



Key features


UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES: Can you handle the bureau’s dark secrets? Unfold an epic supernatural struggle, filled with unexpected characters and bizarre events, as you search for your missing brother, and discover the truth that has brought you here.



EVERYTHING IS YOUR WEAPON: Unleash destruction through transforming weaponry and telekinetic powers. Discover new ways to annihilate your enemies as you harness powerful abilities to turn everything around you into a lethal weapon.



EXPLORE A HIDDEN WORLD: Delve deep into the ominous expanses of a secretive government agency. Explore the Bureau’s shifting environments only to discover that there is always more than meets the eye…



FIGHT FOR CONTROL: Battle a relentless enemy through exciting missions and challenging boss fights to earn powerful upgrades that maximize abilities and customize your weaponry.


CONTROL Ultimate Edition on iOS supports the following MetalFX features:

MetalFX TAAU - Temporal Anti-Aliasing and upscaling
MetalFX Frame Interpolation

Ray-Tracing is supported on devices with M3+ or A19 Pro with 10Gb of memory.

pt.description:
Vocês já está cansado das mesas velhas histórias? Você está interessado em jogos narrativos, romances gráficos, jogos baseados em chat e jogos indie, mas você está cansado da mesma coisa? Se sim, você deveria checar '7Days', um jogo de mistério com romance gráfico e baseado em decisões. 

'7Days' é um jogo narrativo de mistério com romance gráfico. É um jogo narrativo único baseado em decisões onde o usuário pode criar suas histórias baseadas na escolha que ele fizer.

Nós fornecemos a melhor experiência de um jogo narrativo com um enredo de mistério em estilo bate papo, projetado para dispositivos móveis. É um jogo altamente recomendado para você.

■ Jogo explicado
Toda escolha muda a sua história.
Cada pequena escolha irá mudar seu relacionamento com seus companheiros,
e altera seu destino e de seus companheiros nos momentos críticos.

Você pode ser o vilão ou um companheiro de confiança.
Tudo depende de suas escolhas.

■ Resumo
Existem espíritos que foram colocados ao testa para ressurreição no mundo da morte.
O mensageiro da morte os atribuiu com a tarefa de se atacarem ou trabalharem juntos. Seu personagem, Kirell, deve completar tambés as tarefas baseadas em escolhas que lhe foram atribuídas.
Mas suas tarefas necessitam que outros morram...

Você só tem 7 dias
O que você irá escolher?

Experimente está história que provoca a imaginação agora mesmo.

■ Características do jogo
- Estilo quadrinho com gráficos incríveis
- Enredo único que alterna entre a vida e a morte
- O enredo muda de acordo com suas escolhas
- Várias conquistas e desafios ocultos
- Episódios e finais diferentes baseados na história
- Aventura de texto com uma sensação misteriosa
- Enredo excitante

■ Recomendado para aqueles que:
- Estão interessados em conteúdo/texto interativo como romances gráficos, jogos narrativos, jogos de bate papo e jogos sociais
- São apaixonados por jogos indie como 'Undertale'
- Estão procurando por uma jogo narrativo com elementos de mistério e/ou terror
- Estão procurando por O jogo e estão cansados dos jogos narrativos de sempre
- Estão interessados em diferentes tipos de jogos de aventura
Nós também recomendamos 'Underworld Office: Ghost Game', outro de nossos grandes jogos.

■ Nós garantimos a diversão. Baixe e experimente agora

Se você encontrar algum problema ou tem alguma sugestão, por favor, envie para nós em help@buffstudio.com. Nós trabalhamos duro para fazer os melhores jogos de aventura, narrativos, indie, restauradores e romances gráficos.

■ Nós precisamos da sua ajuda para fazer jogos narrativos melhores. Por favor, recomende este jogo narrativo para sua família e amigos. Será de grande ajuda para nós.

pt.description:
Disponível em árabe, inglês, alemão, francês e tcheco!
Jogue no seu idioma nativo ou aproveite para praticar um novo idioma.

Entre no emocionante mundo dos espiões e agentes secretos!
O aplicativo Codenames traz o amado jogo de associação de palavras para o seu dispositivo móvel de uma maneira dinâmica e envolvente. Decifre as pistas de uma palavra dadas pelo seu mestre-espião, conecte as palavras corretas e encontre todos os seus agentes antes que a equipe adversária o faça para garantir a vitória. Esta adaptação digital captura toda a emoção de um dos jogos de tabuleiro mais populares do mundo — agora otimizado para caber no seu bolso.

Um jogo de conexões inteligentes e raciocínio rápido
O aplicativo Codenames oferece uma experiência multijogador assíncrona em que duas equipes rivais se enfrentam em uma batalha de inteligência e criatividade. Seu objetivo? Encontrar a melhor forma de conectar o maior número possível de palavras com uma única pista, superar a equipe adversária e levar seu time à vitória. Jogue com amigos, desafie outros agentes secretos ou divirta-se no modo solo — a diversão estratégica é garantida para todos!

Inspirado no icônico jogo de tabuleiro
Junte-se aos milhões de jogadores ao redor do mundo que se apaixonaram por Codenames. Criado por Vlaada Chvátil, o aplicativo é a mais nova adição à renomada família Codenames. Descubra o jogo que conquistou pessoas de todas as idades e se tornou um verdadeiro fenômeno cultural.

Mais conteúdo, mais diversão
Fiel à mecânica engenhosa do jogo original, o aplicativo Codenames vai além da versão de tabuleiro, oferecendo milhares de novas palavras temáticas e variações empolgantes na jogabilidade. Explore novos modos de jogo, desbloqueie recursos incríveis e conquiste troféus enquanto mergulha ainda mais fundo no universo de Codenames.

Jogue quando e onde quiser
Com nosso sistema multijogador assíncrono, você joga no seu próprio ritmo, sem precisar esperar que os outros estejam online. Cada jogador tem até 24 horas para fazer sua jogada, o que permite adaptar o jogo perfeitamente à sua rotina. Inicie várias partidas, desafie novos jogadores ou aproveite os desafios diários no modo solo.

Construa sua carreira de agente secreto
Suba na hierarquia da sua agência de espionagem, evolua de nível e ganhe recompensas ao longo do caminho. Prove sua habilidade em quebra-cabeças de associação de palavras, desbloqueie dispositivos especiais, novos modos e amplie sua coleção de palavras exclusiva. Mostre seu talento e torne-se o mestre-espião definitivo!

Conecte-se e desafie seus amigos
Desafie seus amigos ou encontre novos oponentes do mundo todo com nosso sistema de matchmaking. Compartilhe conquistas, modos desbloqueados e suas coleções especiais de palavras em partidas amistosas. Seja em jogatinas casuais ou subindo no ranking competitivo, o Codenames App é, acima de tudo, sobre se divertir com palavras.

Codenames App – O jogo de tabuleiro que você adora, reinventado para o seu celular!

1942. Segunda Guerra Mundial. Tu e as tuas tropas estais em serviço no Pacífico – e só pode haver um vencedor…

A batalha continua após "1941 Frozen Front" – e, desta vez, tudo gira em torno da guerra naval! Junta-te à marinha e luta para vencer a batalha da tua vida! Domina o campo de batalha e envia os teus soldados para a linha da frente. Combate militar no seu melhor!

Escolhe as táticas certas e utiliza o teu comando para derrotar o inimigo! Lidera o Exército dos EUA na sua campanha ou comanda as forças japonesas na sua missão! Elimina alianças inimigas com infantaria, artilharia, tanques, aviões de guerra, couraçados e submarinos, e conquista as tuas divisas como um comandante genial na PACIFIC FRONT!

BRIEFING DA MISSÃO

- LUTA com armas poderosas como torpedos e bombas!
- DESTRÓI posições inimigas com tanques e infantaria!
- BOMBARDEIA quartéis-generais hostis com poderosas esquadras de bombardeiros!
- SURPREENDE o inimigo com ataques do teu submarino!
- POSICIONA a tua artilharia em terrenos acidentados!
- LIMPA praias, lagoas e estreitos!
- EMBOSCA o inimigo!
- ABASTECE o teu exército com mercadorias e munições!
- DEFENDE os teus porta-aviões e couraçados!

- Joga sem anúncios!
- Ação estratégica por turnos ambientada na 2ª Guerra Mundial
- Campanhas emocionantes e missões desafiantes

- Infantaria, artilharia, tanques, aviões, couraçados e submarinos para ambas as fações
- Reparação, camuflagem e fortificação de unidades durante as batalhas
- Batalhas multijogador local (Hot-hand)
- Grelha hexagonal para a melhor visão geral possível
- Gráficos detalhados e sons super-realistas
- Suporte total para tablets

Please be sure to check your Storage for the item.



Bug Fixes
- In Death March, destroyed weapons now correctly retain their destroyed status and appearance when continuing to the next battle.
- Fixed an issue in Death March where destroyed weapons were not repaired after selecting "Select another boss" or "Restart from the beginning".
- Fixed a bug where the increased damage from the "Uroboros’s Eye" Handle Fable Arts was not applied correctly.
- Fixed a bug where closing the game with a weapon's durability at 0 caused it to be displayed as destroyed after relaunching the game.
- Fixed a bug where the durability of destroyed weapon were not restored when starting the next playthrough.
- Fixed a bug where the effect of the "Whirlwind Amulet" was activated by certain enemies' dodge actions during combat.
- Fixed a bug where some monsters would not take damage from the "Sharp Pipe" in certain situations.
- Fixed a bug that caused Champion Victor's Phase 1 form to occasionally remain for a short time after entering Phase 2 of his boss fight.
- Fixed a bug where the Two-faced Overseer's boss entrance animation would occasionally not play correctly.
- Adjusted the dialogue order for some NPCs to be more natural.
- Fixed a bug that allowed movement to unintended areas outside the normal route.
- Fixed a bug where Death Ergo was occasionally dropped in an unintended location.
- Fixed a bug where the "Extreme Potential" achievement could not be obtained through "P-Organ Recalibration".
-- Players who encountered this bug can unlock this achievement by loading the affected save data after this patch.
- Fixed typos in the achievement descriptions for Polish and Japanese.
- Fixed a bug where the Motion Blur setting in [Settings → Gameplay → Motion Blur] was not applied correctly.



Known Issues
- Purchasing Lies of P: Overture from the title screen may switch your screen mode to "Borderless Screen Mode" and reset your resolution settings.
You can change your display and resolution settings back in [Settings → Graphics].
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
pt.description:
Você é um títere criado por Geppetto, preso numa teia de mentiras com monstros inimagináveis e figuras pouco confiáveis que ficarão entre você e os eventos no mundo de Lies of P.
 
Uma voz misteriosa desperta você e guia seus passos pela atormentada cidade de Krat — um lugar outrora animado que foi envenenado pela loucura e sede de sangue. Em nosso soulslike, você deve adaptar suas armas e seu personagem para enfrentar horrores incalculáveis, desvendar os segredos insondáveis das elites da cidade e escolher entre confrontar as dificuldades com a verdade ou tecer mentiras para superá-las na jornada para encontrar a si mesmo.


- UM MUNDO SOMBRIAMENTE ELEGANTE E CRUEL
Descubra os segredos da cidade de Krat — um lugar imerso no estilo da era belle époque que já prosperou devido à sua indústria de títeres e agora se encontra com as ruas cobertas de sangue.
 
- LUTE COM INSTRUMENTOS PERVERSOS
Desenvolva um estilo de combate único para combater inimigos e terrenos cruéis, com combinações de armas dinâmicas, o uso de Braço Legionário e a ativação de novas habilidades.
 
- O QUE HÁ EM MENTIR?
Haverá momentos em que você será confrontado com escolhas nas quais poderá mentir para confortar outras pessoas em sofrimento ou desespero… ou poderá optar por dizer a verdade. 
 
 Trace seu próprio caminho.
 
- UM CLÁSSICO REINVENTADO
Experimente o amado conto de fadas de Pinóquio reinterpretado como uma narrativa sombria que permite aos jogadores descobrir os segredos e símbolos escondidos no mundo de Lies of P.

O lendário criador Hideo Kojima traz uma nova experiência no género, agora expandida nesta VERSÃO DO REALIZADOR definitiva. 
 
No futuro, um evento misterioso conhecido como Death Stranding abriu uma porta entre os vivos e os mortos, levando criaturas grotescas da vida após a morte a vaguear por um mundo caído manchado por uma sociedade desolada. 
 
No papel de Sam Bridges, resgata a humanidade ligando os últimos sobreviventes de uma América dizimada. 
 Conseguirás voltar a unir o mundo estilhaçado, passo a passo? 
 
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT para Mac faz uso total dos recursos do Metal 3, como o MetalFX Upscaling, permitindo uma fidelidade gráfica imbatível e um desempenho incrível. Também inclui TAXA ALTA DE FOTOGRAMAS, MODO DE FOTOS e conteúdos interligados da série HALF-LIFE, da Valve Corporation; e de Cyberpunk 2077, da CD Projekt Red. Liga-te a jogadores de todo o mundo com o Social Strand System™.

Mac e iOS
• É necessário iniciar sessão pelo iCloud e ativar o iCloudDrive para jogar este produto.
• Este produto pode ser jogado offline, mas é necessária uma ligação à internet para tirar o proveito máximo do Social Strand System™. Serão cobradas taxas de comunicação ao jogar online.

Apenas para a versão iOS

pt.description:
A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated

Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps.

This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher.

Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done.

You get:

- Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps
- Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need
- Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message
- Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand
- Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus
- Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision
- Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities
- Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions
- Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have

Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price.

With Goblin Tools Pro, you can:

- Keep your data continuously synced between devices
- Create and reuse templates for to-do items
- Share the lists you create
- Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice
- Access your history across all Goblin Tools
- Use additional Pro features as they are introduced

Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate.

It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more.

Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

pt.description:
Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you.

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge!
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

■ Unique Heroes — Not just different stats. A completely different way to play.

Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.

…Every hero demands a different strategy.

■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy.

Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot

Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary
Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations.

■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything.

Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.

Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases.

■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here.

Normal mode is only the beginning.
As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await.

Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations.

■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week.

Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week.
Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work.

Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings.
Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle.

How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger?

■ Endless Replayability

3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time

Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike.

■ Features

Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite
Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings
Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies
Procedurally generated dungeons
Multiple languages supported
Cloud save

Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.
